notes_for_editor: Identity unconfirmed. The firelookout.ca entry says in its own words that the tower is a guess, based on a topographic tower symbol and a 1963 map that shows an 80 ft steel tower in the general vicinity without naming Tim Lake. The record's coordinates (45.748281, -80.448512) sit about 1.4 degrees of longitude west of the Tim River access point the park gives (45.740064, -79.060106), and the Forestry Tower Road named in the entry is the road the park directs visitors along from Highway 518 near Kearney. The record's point therefore looks wrong, but no source gives a correct tower location, so no correction is proposed. Kind and status are both 'unknown' in the record. Nothing found on build date, staffing, fires or fate. A person should decide whether to keep the record and which point to use. Nothing was checked on site.
